title: ibm-1 source card
description: Which ibm state variables a source realizes, and how. See data/README.md and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.

access.description: held: bytes acquired. priority: queued. restricted: needs a DUA. watch: not yet released or terms unresolved. reference: never a training source.

binding.description: Whether every stream's `constrains` and `via` resolve against the registry. Only `bound` cards may be used for fitting.

frames.description: Coordinate frames this source speaks. Every position it reports lives in one of these; the materializer inserts warps.

kind.description: measured: contributes a likelihood term. imposed: conditioned on, never modelled as sampled.

constrains.description: Registered ibm component ids this stream bears on. Empty while unbound.

via.description: Registered process id producing the observed variable from brain state. Null while unbound.

observation_chain.description: Prose chain carried over from the source's own documentation, to be replaced by `via`.

band_hz.description: [lo, hi] temporal band this stream can constrain. Set by sampling rate and by any filtering already applied.

confounds.description: Alternative explanations of this stream that are not the state of interest.

temporal_support.description: Prose sampling description carried from the source, pending resolution into rate_hz and band_hz.

absent.description: Streams this source does NOT have. Absent is not zero; a missing stream is missing evidence, and the materializer must not read silence as a measurement.

requires.description: Geometry a stream needs before it can be attributed to a support at all — electrode positions, head models, display geometry.

use.description: What this source is permitted to do. `fit` is the only one that updates theta from a likelihood.

forbidden.description: Update paths this source must never take, e.g. 'no subject-specific head geometry from a template montage'.

distillation.description: Required when `use` includes `distil`. A teacher writes evidence, so it must declare the precision that evidence carries. See ARCHITECTURE.md, distillation precision.

source.description: Where the figure comes from. A number we did not verify is marked as such.

form.description: residual_variance: dJ = 1 / ((1 - r2) * Var[x]). flat: a declared constant, used only when no accuracy figure exists.

ood_inflation_prior.description: Prior on the variance inflation applied when used off the benchmark distribution. Not a constant.

error_rank.description: Rank q of the shared-error subspace B. With `correlated_fraction` it fixes how much of a teacher's apparent precision survives. A teacher's residuals covary across everything it writes, so a diagonal increment overstates what it knows.

correlated_fraction.description: Fraction rho of the teacher's error variance that is SHARED across the values it writes, rather than independent per value. Residual covariance is modelled as diag((1-rho)*v) + B B^T with B of rank `error_rank`; the precision contributed is that inverted, which by Woodbury is a diagonal MINUS a low-rank correction. The sign is the point: shared error does not add a constraint, it subtracts confidence that correlated values would otherwise appear to supply. At rho=0.9 a teacher writing 10^4 values contributes roughly the precision of one independent measurement. Null means unmeasured, which must be treated as high rather than zero.

effective_constraints.description: Derived, not declared: the number of independent measurements this teacher's contribution is worth, computed from `correlated_fraction` and `error_rank`. Recorded so a materialization can report it rather than leaving a reader to infer it from a rank.
